title: Curator-Controlled Story Recommendations with Object-Craft Workshop Linkages

recommendation_engine.linkage_mechanism: Rule-based object -> craft workshop linkages using verified relational evidence (e.g. associated_craft, cultural_trade in heritage_heritage_relations)

endpoint.description: Returns curated story and verified craft workshop recommendations with historical justifications

cultural_bridge_integration.enhancement: Seamlessly integrates verified living artisan & workshop linkages (linked_creator_slug, linked_creator_name, linked_experience_slug, linked_experience_title)

features: Displays verified historical linkage badge ('Verified Heritage Link' / 'Liên kết thẩm định')
Includes clear artisan dignity note separating 1835 royal antiquities from modern living practitioners
Fails closed when no verified recommendations exist
frontend_components.story_page_integration: Embedded in frontend/src/app/stories/[slug]/page.jsx beneath bibliographic footnotes

negative_abuse_invariants.unverified_artisan_hidden: Artisans with pending_review, unverified status, or missing consent are strictly excluded from recommendations
negative_abuse_invariants.unverified_commercial_hidden: Commercial experiences not linked to verified consented creators are strictly filtered out
negative_abuse_invariants.no_fake_imperial_lineage: check_fake_imperial_lineage scans bio, lineage, and experience descriptions, strictly blocking claims of royal authorization, royal descendant urn casters, or imperial relic sales

verification_results.type_check: tsc --noEmit passed cleanly with zero errors
